CustomField.description: Per-section multi-select of Salesforce matching rule developer names used to find existing Leads for this section's related records during conversion. Read by Form_Submission_Convert_Setup's getPageSection branch as the section's own value; a blank checks every active Lead matching rule. The section never inherits the Form Template's Lead Matching Rules. Works with Update Most Confident Lead.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose which Lead matching rules conversion uses for this section's data. Leave blank to check every active Lead matching rule; pair with Update Most Confident Lead to control how multiple matches resolve.
CustomField.label: Lead Matching Rules
